items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Art was a personal friend that I met.

ctx.x: I told him, I preferred to be here, because I just one thing -- in any case, even if I was broke and out of a job, I would never take it, because it was Art Whetsol's job, rhythm.
Chief. Art Whetsol was with him. and he was blown to death by Duke's orchestra, and I know, because Art was a personal friend that I met.
